# Third-party implementation status

No upstream repository snapshot is intentionally bundled here.  The audited
compressor adaptations in `src/fata/runtimes/` lack recoverable upstream
commit and redistribution-license metadata, so publication requires owner and
license review.  See `docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and
`docs/LICENSING_REVIEW_REQUIRED.md` before distributing this tree.
